title: git-test-repositories says which git commands refuse a branch held through a rebase's update-refs, and with which error
goal: The fact at kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md on update-refs holders is split: die_if_checked_out (checkout, switch, rebase, worktree add) knows HEAD, a detached rebase and bisect; update-refs blocks branch -f and new-branch validation only, with its own error text
